title: Production change, release authorization and rollback
workflow: Link scope change to approved requirement and ADR
Assess banking, privacy, security, reporting and integration impacts
Verify actual tests, migration compatibility and deployment artifact hash
Obtain independent risk-based approvals and production window
Deploy canary or staged rollout with reconciliation/health monitoring
Suspend or compensate safely and publish post-change evidence
invariants: No approval is inferred from merge or ZIP upload
Changing finance policy requires independent CFO acceptance
Rollback cannot erase a posted journal or settled external operation
Emergency changes have bounded privileges and retrospective review
Configuration and source changes carry exact effective date/version
Release cannot use untested binary or wrong institution credentials
Every material change has immutable before/after audit
acceptance_tests: Reject production change without signed role approvals
Post-deploy rollback does not mutate financial history
independent_gate: Approved change board, trusted build chain and executed release/recovery rehearsals.
